let NONCAPTURE_GATE_STATE='UNUSED';
function noncaptureBinding(){demand(EXEC.status==='ISSUED','execution_binding_unissued');demand(typeof EXEC.nonce==='string'&&/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(EXEC.nonce)&&EXEC.attempt===1&&typeof EXEC.session==='string'&&/^rea-greenly-lca-[a-z0-9-]{1,80}$/.test(EXEC.session),'NONCAPTURE_BINDING');demand(EXEC.nativeUnit==='rea-greenly-lca-'+EXEC.nonce+'.service'&&EXEC.nativeDescription==='rea-greenly-noncapture:'+EXEC.nonce,'NONCAPTURE_UNIT');demand(typeof EXEC.output==='string'&&path.isAbsolute(EXEC.output)&&!EXEC.output.split('/').includes('..')&&EXEC.output.endsWith('/run1'),'NONCAPTURE_OUTPUT');demand(Number.isFinite(TASK_END)&&TASK_END<=STOP&&remaining()>0,'NONCAPTURE_DEADLINE');}
function receiveNoncaptureGate(stream,nonce,milliseconds){demand(/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(nonce)&&Number.isFinite(milliseconds)&&milliseconds>0&&milliseconds<=3000,'NONCAPTURE_GATE_SHAPE');return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const expected=Buffer.from('REA_NONCAPTURE_START_V1:'+nonce+'\n');let bytes=Buffer.alloc(0),done=false;const finish=(error)=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(timer);stream.off('data',data);stream.off('end',end);stream.off('error',errorFn);stream.pause();error?reject(Error('NONCAPTURE_GATE_REFUSED')):resolve(true);};const data=b=>{if(!Buffer.isBuffer(b))return finish(true);if(bytes.length+b.length>expected.length)return finish(true);bytes=Buffer.concat([bytes,b]);if(!expected.subarray(0,bytes.length).equals(bytes))finish(true);};const end=()=>finish(!bytes.equals(expected));const errorFn=()=>finish(true);const timer=setTimeout(()=>finish(true),milliseconds);stream.on('data',data);stream.once('end',end);stream.once('error',errorFn);stream.resume();});}
function noncaptureNative(){noncaptureBinding();const r=cp.spawnSync('/usr/bin/systemctl',['show',EXEC.nativeUnit,'--property=Id,ActiveState,MainPID,InvocationID,Description,ControlGroup,MemoryMax,MemorySwapMax,TasksMax,RuntimeMaxUSec,TimeoutStartUSec,TimeoutStopUSec,KillMode,NoNewPrivileges,ProtectProc,ProcSubset,ReadWritePaths'],{encoding:'utf8',timeout:Math.max(1,Math.min(500,remaining())),maxBuffer:16384,env:{PATH:'/usr/bin:/bin',LC_ALL:'C'}});demand(r.status===0&&!r.error,'NONCAPTURE_NATIVE');const p={};for(const line of r.stdout.trim().split('\n')){const i=line.indexOf('=');demand(i>0&&!Object.hasOwn(p,line.slice(0,i)),'NONCAPTURE_NATIVE');p[line.slice(0,i)]=line.slice(i+1);}const expected={Id:EXEC.nativeUnit,ActiveState:'active',MainPID:String(process.pid),Description:EXEC.nativeDescription,MemoryMax:'134217728',MemorySwapMax:'0',TasksMax:'32',KillMode:'control-group',NoNewPrivileges:'yes',ProtectProc:'invisible',ProcSubset:'pid',ReadWritePaths:EXEC.output};demand(Object.entries(expected).every(([k,v])=>p[k]===v)&&/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(p.InvocationID||'')&&p.ControlGroup?.endsWith('/'+EXEC.nativeUnit)&&timeMicros(p.RuntimeMaxUSec)===9000000&&timeMicros(p.TimeoutStartUSec)===1000000&&timeMicros(p.TimeoutStopUSec)===1000000,'NONCAPTURE_NATIVE');const status=readCap('/proc/'+process.pid+'/status',16384).toString('utf8');demand(/^Uid:\s+1000\s+1000\s+1000\s+1000$/m.test(status)&&/^NoNewPrivs:\s+1$/m.test(status),'NONCAPTURE_UID');demand(readCap('/proc/'+process.pid+'/cgroup',8192).toString('utf8').trim()==='0::'+p.ControlGroup,'NONCAPTURE_CGROUP');demand(fs.readlinkSync('/proc/self/ns/pid')===fs.readlinkSync('/proc/'+PID+'/ns/pid'),'NONCAPTURE_PID_NAMESPACE');const fd=fs.openSync('/control/HOST_MEMINFO',fs.constants.O_RDONLY|fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW|fs.constants.O_NONBLOCK);try{const m=fs.fstatSync(fd,{bigint:true});demand(m.isFile()&&m.uid===0n&&m.nlink===1n&&BigInt(fs.statfsSync('/proc/self/fd/'+fd,{bigint:true}).type)===0x9fa0n,'NONCAPTURE_MEMINFO');validateMeminfoMounts(readCap('/proc/'+process.pid+'/mountinfo',131072).toString('utf8'),m.dev);const ram=readCap('/control/HOST_MEMINFO',65536).toString('utf8');demand(Number(/^MemAvailable:\s+(\d+)\s+kB/m.exec(ram)?.[1])*1024>=4*1073741824,'RAM_GUARD');}finally{fs.closeSync(fd);}return p;}
async function noncaptureStartupGate(){demand(NONCAPTURE_GATE_STATE==='UNUSED','NONCAPTURE_GATE_REPLAY');noncaptureBinding();NONCAPTURE_GATE_STATE='WAITING';try{await receiveNoncaptureGate(process.stdin,EXEC.nonce,Math.min(3000,remaining()));const p=noncaptureNative();demand(remaining()>0&&Date.now()<TASK_END-22000,'NONCAPTURE_DEADLINE');const q=noncaptureNative();demand(p.InvocationID===q.InvocationID&&p.MainPID===q.MainPID&&p.ControlGroup===q.ControlGroup,'NONCAPTURE_EPOCH_CHANGED');NONCAPTURE_GATE_STATE='OPEN';return true;}catch(e){NONCAPTURE_GATE_STATE='FAILED';throw Error('NONCAPTURE_GATE_REFUSED');}}

function validateMeminfoMounts(text,device){
 demand(typeof text==='string'&&Buffer.byteLength(text)<=131072,'meminfo_mountinfo_bound');const lines=text.trim().split('\n');demand(lines.length>0&&lines.length<=512,'meminfo_mountinfo_count');let alias=null,proc=null;
 const dev=BigInt(device),major=((dev>>8n)&0xfffn)|((dev>>32n)&0xfffff000n),minor=(dev&0xffn)|((dev>>12n)&0xffffff00n),devText=major.toString()+':'+minor.toString();
 for(const line of lines){demand(line.length<=2048,'meminfo_mountinfo_line');const parts=line.split(' - ');demand(parts.length===2,'meminfo_mountinfo_shape');const a=parts[0].split(' '),b=parts[1].split(' ');demand(a.length>=6&&b.length>=3,'meminfo_mountinfo_shape');if(a[4]==='/control/HOST_MEMINFO'){demand(alias===null,'meminfo_duplicate_mount');alias={a,b};}if(a[4]==='/proc'){demand(proc===null,'meminfo_duplicate_proc_mount');proc={a,b};}}
 demand(alias&&alias.a[2]===devText&&alias.a[3]==='/meminfo'&&alias.b[0]==='proc'&&alias.b[1]==='proc'&&alias.a[5].split(',').includes('ro')&&!alias.a[5].split(',').includes('rw'),'meminfo_readonly_mount');
 demand(proc&&proc.b[0]==='proc'&&proc.b[1]==='proc'&&proc.b[2].split(',').includes('subset=pid')&&proc.b[2].split(',').some(x=>x==='hidepid=invisible'||x==='hidepid=2'),'meminfo_private_proc_mount');
 return true;
}
